calendar_changes.meaning: Exact saved list changes are separate from future-date changes, removal of elapsed dates and projection metadata. None is called a newly source-verified opening.

citynews.scope: Exact existing Citynews detail URLs; a successful read can still have a held identity or unsupported layout.

happings_details.scope: Observed URLs can include events that are not markets; successful fetch is not a catalog identity match.

happings_legacy.scope: Legacy routing queue: a resolved provincial resource is not proof that market fields were refreshed.

evidence_changes.meaning: Changes are compared across complete exported snapshots; this is not attribution of every change to one source reader.

dev.scope: Only the supplied local snapshot was checked. No network deployment or live source was checked by this utility.

preview.scope: Only the supplied local snapshot was checked. No network deployment or live source was checked by this utility.

definitions.legacy_semantics: The established comparator runs unchanged. Its reported_future_date_records_without_valid_calendar only covers its existing calendario_fonte validator; the supplement separately counts valid editorial reported dates.

field_recency.meaning: Uses field_evidence.field_states and exact surviving identity/value-bound receipts. A recent read of old publisher content remains historical. Unknown publisher dates remain unknown.

definitions.receipt_age_counts: Row/field categories, not additive receipt totals. Distinct independent receipts can put the same row/field into more than one age category.
definitions.editorial: Uses clean_editorial_evidence, valid_editorial_reported_dates and apply_editorial_scope. Edition intervals remain intervals; no daily dates are generated.
definitions.citynews: Only exact Citynews source identities recognized by citynews_urls count. Historical editions and unknown modification dates remain distinct from current facts. All Citynews editorial evidence uses the production common validator.
definitions.archived: An archive marker or wholly past edition is not a statement of permanent market closure.
definitions.reported_dates: Exact saved future dates labelled riportata are counted separately from prevista/confermata. A proof is source attribution, not independent opening confirmation. Outside two proof families is not automatically an invalid official-source date.
definitions.roma: Row AGGIORNATO from the bound hours receipt stays separate from acquisition and distribution-upload dates. All Roma IDs and unchanged primary source dates are measured.
definitions.queues: A read is a recorded successful transport, not a field update or truth guarantee. Never-read means absent successful reads in the saved queue only. An absent queue means history unavailable. Attempt cycles are separate from successful-read cycles.
definitions.queue_migration: The production EES/CDC validator may migrate schema1 to schema2 in memory. Stored schema and raw file hash stay separate from normalized validation semantics. Equivalent migrated semantics do not imply equal published bytes.
definitions.happings_refresh: The 7-day scheduler target is measured as a target; it does not promise complete weekly coverage. Sitemap reads and detail reads are separated.
definitions.equality: candidate/dev/preview equality requires identical catalog rows, validated immutable manifest bytes/signatures and persisted queue presence/bytes. These are supplied local snapshots, not live site checks.
definitions.source_truth_limit: This audit performs no source reads and cannot establish that all market facts or future openings are current or true.
